_about: Prices of Freitty network facilities, copied from Freitty Hub → Facility Passport → Prices (excl. taxes). Hub is the source of truth; re-collect and replace this file when prices change. 0 means the field is empty in Hub.
source: Freitty Hub · Facility Passport · Prices (excl. taxes)

categories.name: Consolidation
categories.hint: Flat fee per operation: load planning, arranging cargo placement within the trailer, taking into account axle weight limits, unloading sequence, and cargo compatibility. Pallet handling billed separately at Cross-dock rates.

categories.name: Cross-Dock
categories.hint: Freitty standard pricing principle: inbound is free, the full rate is charged on outbound. The rate you enter is the complete price per pallet for the entire service — inbound and outbound combined. It will not be doubled or split at billing. Example: if you enter $7, the customer pays $7 per pallet total — not $7 in + $7 out. This one-rate model keeps quotes simple for customers and consistently brings partners more orders. If your operation prices inbound and outbound separately, add them together and enter the combined figure as one rate.

categories.name: Deconsolidation
categories.hint: Flat fee per operation: breaking down an inbound load into multiple outbound shipments — sorting, staging by destination, and preparing each shipment for dispatch. Pallet handling billed separately at Cross-dock rates.

categories.name: Disassembled pallet
categories.hint: Price to break down / disassemble a pallet, by size.

categories.name: Fix Pallet
categories.hint: Price to repair or rebuild a damaged or unstable pallet, by size. IMPORTANT: It's not a price for REWORK/RESTACK service.

categories.name: Hand Work
categories.hint: Hourly labor rate for manual handling not covered by a fixed service (hand-sort, loose pieces).

categories.name: Overweight
categories.hint: Flat fee per operation: load planning and re-arranging cargo to meet axle weight limits. Unloading/loading of pallets billed separately at Cross-dock rates.

categories.name: Rebanding - Strapping
categories.hint: Price to re-band or re-strap freight, by size.

categories.name: Reefer Storage
categories.hint: Storage charge per pallet per day for temperature-controlled (reefer) storage.

categories.name: Scale pallet
categories.hint: Price to weigh a pallet, by size.

categories.name: Trailer parking daily
categories.hint: Charge to park a trailer in your yard, per day.

categories.name: Trailer Parking Monthly
categories.hint: Charge to park a trailer in your yard, per week.

categories.name: Trailer Parking Weekly
categories.hint: Charge to park a trailer in your yard, per week.

categories.name: Trailer Rent
categories.hint: Price to rent out one of your own trailers, per day.

categories.name: Wrapping
categories.hint: Price to stretch- or shrink-wrap a pallet, by size.

categories.name: Storage Pricing
categories.hint: Charge per pallet per day for storage after the free period.

fieldHints.Minimal charge: The minimum charge for any job, regardless of size — bookings can’t price below this.
fieldHints.Open-deck service: Flat charge for handling freight on or off a flatbed / open-deck trailer.
fieldHints.Call fee first hour: Charge for the first hour of an after-hours / on-call job.
fieldHints.Call fee extra hours: Hourly rate for each additional hour after the first on an after-hours job.
